senses.gloss: m. (cmp. צמצם) [contraction, wrinkle,] the last stage in the growth of the fig; trnsf. the stage of complete puberty of woman, v. בּוֹחַל.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 47a:35-36">Ib. 47ᵃ</cite> (phonetic etymology) <he>כמ״ד יצ̇תה מ̇ל̇אה</he> as one says, it has come forth complete.
<cite ref="Niddah 47b:6">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ מלמעלה</he> the symptom of complete puberty on the upper part of the body.
